title: Introduction to Art Education I
description: A foundation course for those interested in teaching art in school or community settings. Working in various studio activities, students build knowledge and skill in studio art while considering how those experiences may be adapted for young learners. Art education topics include artistic development, critical and cultural perspectives on art and teaching methodologies.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of AE 103A, AE 103, AE 100, AE 101, AE 204, ED-A 701, EDCI 307, EDCI 307A, EDCI 307B, EDUC 307.
Students planning to emphasize art in their degree program should register in this course.
